project.title: Accurate Quantitative 16S and ITS Sequencing of Samples in Wastewater Treatment Plants
project.description: A quantitative analysis of the distribution characteristics and concentrations of pathogenic bacteria and fungi across multiple sample types in wastewater treatment plants, including three distinct environmental sample categories (aerosols, wastewater, and particulates), under two different climatic conditions, and utilizing two sequencing approaches.
